data.one_liner: A Flutter TabBar where each tab indicator is a toggle button.
data.what_it_does: Implements a customizable TabBar widget where each tab acts as an interactive toggle button with individual styles, background colors, borders, and smooth transition animations. It integrates with TabController and DefaultTabController from the material_ui package.
use_when: You want a tab bar styled as toggle buttons rather than standard underlined tabs
You need custom backgrounds, borders, or gradients per tab state
avoid_when: Your project relies strictly on package:flutter/material.dart and you cannot migrate to material_ui
You require the default platform-native tab styling without button wrappers
strengths: Highly customizable tab appearance with support for gradients, borders, and rounded corners
Easy integration with standard TabBarView and TabController workflows
weaknesses: Requires the standalone material_ui package and Flutter 3.47.0+ in version 2.0.0
Not compatible out-of-the-box with apps using standard package:flutter/material.dart without staying on older versions
data.setup_notes: Add dependencies for buttons_tabbar and material_ui to pubspec.yaml, and ensure your app meets the minimum Flutter version requirement of 3.47.0.
